prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE isolated paper clue-object sprite and closeup original for a hand-painted campus escape game. One open old university chemistry experiment notebook with a worn muted teal cloth cover and cream paper, faint empty graph-paper lines on one page and several blank outlined table cells on the other. No formula, chemical symbols, letters, numbers, diagrams, vials or separate objects. Clearly a lab record notebook through materials and grid layout alone. Detailed soft gouache and colored-pencil illustration with tactile paper fibers, gentle wear and clear readable silhouette; same old-campus hand-painted aesthetic, no photography/3D or flat vector. Viewed at a moderately raised front three-quarter angle so the broad paper surface is visible, slight perspective, centered. Warm upper-left soft light with cool ambient edge shading. Whole object fully in frame, at least 10% transparent padding; no desk, floor, background or cast shadow plane. Genuine alpha transparent background, not black/white/checkerboard. One object only, not a sheet of multiple sprites. No human/hand, secret/code/answer, watermark, logo or UI. Landscape 5:4 high resolution ideally 1400x1120.
